headline: JetBlue Creditors Work with Restructuring Adviser PJT Partners
summary: Creditors of JetBlue Airways are working with restructuring advisory firm PJT Partners, according to market reports, as the US carrier evaluates options for managing balance sheet obligations.
why: JetBlue is a major passenger airline operator in North America facing post-pandemic balance sheet liabilities.

impacts.name: JetBlue Airways Corp.
impacts.why: Creditor engagement with restructuring firms signals potential debt renegotiations or credit risks.

why_moved: Reports that creditors hired debt restructuring advisers highlighted financial leverage concerns for the carrier.
